entries.title: 'Her body temperature was 106': How heat is killing Americans in their homes
entries.snippet: Heat kills thousands of people across the U.S. every year. The risk is especially high for the millions of Americans who live in manufactured housing like mobile homes and trailers.

entries.snippet: Fifth graders calm school kindergartners in Los Angeles. Kids take the "bike bus" in Oklahoma. High school students take in a new high school building in Oregon.

entries.title: Morning news brief

entries.title: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
entries.snippet: An Amazon Prime cargo plane was landing at the airport around 2 p.m. ET on Sunday when it overran the runway, crashed and rammed into vehicles on the ground, according to FAA.

entries.title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
entries.snippet: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.

entries.title: American Muslims are giving Texas barbecue a halal makeover

entries.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
entries.snippet: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.

entries.title: Nepal holds a day of mourning after floods kill at least 1,300 people
entries.snippet: Monday was the 13th day since the flooding which killed more than 1,300 people in Nepal and Tibet and left some 5,000 missing, including foreigners, according to Nepal's disaster management agency.

entries.title: King Charles clarifies status of Prince Harry and Meghan in a letter after their return to the UK
entries.snippet: King Charles III has reiterated that Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, remain non-working members of the royal family following their return to the United Kingdom.

entries.title: Russia shuts German consulate in St. Petersburg in tit-for-tat move after Leipzig drone incident
entries.snippet: Russia's Foreign Ministry has announced the closure of the German consulate in St. Petersburg, a move that reflects the ongoing tensions between the two countries.

entries.title: 'Widow's Bay' dominates with 8 Emmys at early ceremony, while 'The Pitt' takes 4
entries.snippet: "Widow's Bay" ran away with eight early Emmys for its debut season Sunday at a ceremony eight days before the main awards show and telecast, while "The Pitt" had a strong second-year showing with four of its own.

entries.title: Federal investigators probe Amazon cargo jet's fiery runway crash that killed 5 in Miami

entries.title: Hawaii residents told to expect tropical storm conditions as Hurricane Lowell passes to the west
entries.snippet: The Miami-based center issued the warning for Kauai and Niihau as Lowell was forecast to pass the islands to the west late Monday and Tuesday while traveling north.

entries.title: At least 5 dead after Amazon cargo plane barreled off runway at Miami airport
entries.snippet: The aircraft overran the runway around 2 p.m. after arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico. Five people were killed, three critically injured and two others hospitalized with less severe injuries, Miami-Dade County officials told a news conference.

entries.title: Explosion of fireworks in central Mexico kills at least 10, injures 64
entries.snippet: The explosion occurred Saturday night next to the Nuestra Señora de la Luz church in Temascalcingo, a municipality in central Mexico with 66,000 residents.

entries.title: Decades after 9/11, toxic dust and PTSD may be accelerating brain aging among first responders
entries.snippet: From intense psychological trauma to exposure to neurotoxic dust, first responders at Ground Zero continue to confront significant physical and mental health risks.

entries.title: Iran says it plans to announce a new 'exclusion zone' near the Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: Mohsen Rezaei's comments to Iran's state broadcaster came with few details, a day after the U.S. struck three Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran launching ballistic missiles at U.S. warships.

entries.title: German far-right party set for regional election triumph but uncertain of governing
entries.snippet: Alternative for Germany, or AfD, went into the vote seeking an absolute majority in the state legislature to govern on its own. That would overcome the so-called firewall of mainstream parties' refusal to work with AfD.

entries.title: U.S. tourism groups want to win Canadian visitors back. A testy trade war isn't helping
entries.snippet: The bilateral rift has not stopped state and local tourism officials and popular destinations like Graceland from trying to persuade Canadian visitors to return.

entries.title: California made Gavin Newsom famous. Will it drag down his 2028 presidential ambitions?
entries.snippet: California's Democratic governor has barely begun to address what may be his biggest political liability as he stakes a claim as an early front-runner in the Democratic Party's 2028 shadow primary.

entries.title: Infantino to stand for re-election as FIFA president despite failed World Cup sell-off plan
entries.snippet: Despite widespread calls for him to step down, FIFA said Infantino will seek next year to win a fourth and final term in office through 2031.

entries.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in Ukraine after meeting with Putin
entries.snippet: The trip by the Americans follows a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Saturday, as both sides have escalated their aerial attacks.

entries.title: Volcanic island in Indonesia erupts, forcing the cancellation of hundreds of flights

entries.title: Trump administration makes another appeal to Supreme Court to allow mail ballot restrictions
entries.snippet: The filing came after U.S. District Court Judge Indira Talwani extended an order against the Postal Service enforcing President Donald Trump's executive order for the November elections.

entries.title: Here's a look at 'reach' election races where Democrats hope to pull off House upsets

entries.title: Why Mexican cartels are increasingly using car bombs and other explosives

entries.title: Flock cameras become midterm campaign target as voters balk at tech companies' power
entries.snippet: Although police say the cameras are an invaluable crime-fighting tool, some critics say their pervasiveness amounts to unconstitutional warrantless mass surveillance.

entries.title: Nicaragua challenges German arms exports to Israel at ICJ
entries.snippet: Germany has asked the International Court of Justice to dismiss the case on jurisdiction grounds. It also said its arms exports to Israel were documented, published, and subject to more stringent checks than most.

entries.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Germany wakes up to 'unsettling' AfD victory

entries.title: Can the AfD form a government in Saxony-Anhalt?

entries.title: Russia announces it is closing Germany's consulate in St. Petersburg

entries.title: War criminal Ratko Mladic buried with military honors in Belgrade, Serbia
entries.snippet: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, comes just days before President Vucic is expected to call an election.

entries.snippet: A visibly shaken but also determined Friedrich Merz spoke in Berlin about the AfD's election victory in Saxony-Anhalt and the CDU's bitter defeat. He insisted on sticking to his reforms.

entries.title: Carbon capture tech exists. Scaling it up is the hard part

entries.title: Pakistan: Can creating new provinces fix governance?
entries.snippet: Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution.

entries.title: EU's Von der Leyen pledges $232 million Greenland investment
entries.snippet: The EU is preparing a major investment package and closer political ties with the Danish Arctic territory amid Donald Trump's demand for greater US control of the mineral-rich island.

entries.title: Threatening letters revive fears among Kashmiri Pandits

entries.title: Russia opens first road bridge with North Korea

entries.title: Middle East: Israeli strikes kill a dozen in Lebanon

entries.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says war looks set to go on into winter

entries.title: UK government condemns 'thuggish' anti-migrant protests in Portsmouth

entries.title: India news: Rescue efforts underway in deadly Delhi building collapse

entries.title: Jamaica to petition King Charles over slavery reparations

entries.title: Several killed in Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
entries.snippet: At least five people have died after a cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport. The aircraft overran a runway, struck several vehicles and caught fire.

entries.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin

entries.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Digesting the AfD's landmark election win
